canada.title: Housing is not merely a social service; it is a foundation for dignity, health, and labour rights
canada.summary: A fair society does not force people to choose between a worker's right to dignity and a disabled person's right to support. It recognizes that both rights depend on the same foundation: adequately funded public services, accessible environments, and a commitment to human dignity.

canada.title: Inuk man grieves brother who died accompanying him for medical treatment in Dorval, Que.
canada.summary: Montreal police say a 69-year-old man has died after being struck by an SUV in the West Island suburb of Dorval. The collision occurred near the Ullivik Centre, which houses Inuit patients from Nunavik seeking medical treatment in Montreal.

canada.title: N.L. spent $32.1 million in 2.5 years on private virtual health-care services
canada.summary: A mayor in rural Newfoundland says most people in his community who needed urgent care in the past few years arrived at the local health centre and "talked to a TV."

canada.title: Sask.'s CWD testing program reinstated after feedback from hunters, province says
canada.summary: After a week of backlash from hunters and organizations, the Saskatchewan government has announced its chronic wasting disease testing program will continue to run for the 2026-27 season.

canada.title: B.C. jury finds Adam Mann guilty in 2024 home-invasion murder of Tori Dunn
canada.summary: The man accused of killing Surrey, B.C., resident Tory Dunn during a home invasion two years ago has been convicted of second-degree murder.

canada.title: 3 arrested after string of online marketplace robberies, $80K in Pokemon cards among targets: Toronto police
canada.summary: Three people have been arrested after an investigation into a string of violent robberies linked to online marketplace transactions, including the theft of an $80,000 Pokémon card collection, Toronto police say.

canada.title: N.S. woman says duct-cleaning company used AI-generated photos to fake work
canada.summary: A Dartmouth, N.S. woman says her recent experience with a duct-cleaning company has left her feeling scammed and alleges she was shown AI-generated photos of supposed work.

canada.title: Chum salmon counted by Klondike River sonar for first time, amid alarming drop in numbers downstream
canada.summary: A new pilot project is giving researchers in the Yukon’s Dawson City area an opportunity to get a clearer picture of how chum salmon are doing in the region.

canada.title: The best of the best in Blue and Gold
canada.summary: No one would use the word “outstanding” to describe this year’s Winnipeg Blue Bombers.

canada.title: ‘Part of the city’s DNA’: Former BioWare writer reflects on company's impact on Edmonton
canada.summary: Videogame developer BioWare announced Wednesday it will be closing its doors after operating in Edmonton for more than 30 years. BioWare produced numerous popular game franchises such as Mass Effect and Baldur's Gate.

canada.title: Joly says Stelco still planning mass layoffs, gives business 2 weeks to reverse or face legal action
canada.summary: Industry Minister Melanie Joly has given Stelco 15 days to make good on its agreements with the Canadian government or face legal action.

canada.title: Former Alberta cabinet minister says Smith can’t survive UCP crisis after referendum
canada.summary: A former Alberta cabinet minister says Premier Danielle Smith won't survive the crisis in her United Conservative Party amid fallout from the separation referendum.

canada.title: Quebec Superior Court hears arguments to suspend Montreal bylaw banning insults
canada.summary: Lawyers are asking Quebec Superior Court to suspend a recently-adopted bylaw banning insults against employees of the city of Montreal, including police officers.

canada.title: May preliminary inquiry for man accused of Moncton murder
canada.summary: A preliminary inquiry has been scheduled for next spring for a man accused of a murder in Moncton.

canada.title: Man charged with murder in death of 20-year-old in Regina
canada.summary: A 25-year-old man was charged with first-degree murder in relation to the killing of Deandre Lagimodiere, 20, the Regina Police Service said.

canada.title: Unhappy N.B. Tory says he’s launching new right-wing party
canada.summary: A Progressive Conservative unhappy that Daniel Allain won the party leadership says he is going to start a centre-right party called the New Brunswick Party.

canada.title: Fall storm could bring 15-25 cm of snow to northern Manitoba
canada.summary: A "significant fall storm" is headed to northern Manitoba, bringing rain that will transition into heavy, wet snow with as much as 15 to 25 centimetres expected, says Environment Canada.

canada.title: Tumbler Ridge conspiracy suspect James Bryant pleads not guilty in U.S. court
canada.summary: The alleged co-conspirator in the deadly mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge, B.C., has pleaded not guilty in a U.S. court and is set to go on trial in December.
